title: Kami: a Claude Code skill that enforces one design language across every document it generates

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: AI generated documents all look the same. Generic corporate gray or SAS gradient suit. Kami is a clawed code skill that enforces a single design language across every format. Warm parchment canvas, ink, blue accent, serif for authority, sands for utility. Ask for a white paper, resume, pitch deck or portfolio and it auto triggers.
